subject: Day 11: register for music or baby class; weight check followup
bodyText:
Today's focus
Day 11. Avi has likely crossed back over birth weight. If he has not, today is the latest reasonable day to escalate the weight check. Pediatrician follow-up should be scheduled for the 1-month visit window (day 28-35). The lochia is transitioning to lochia alba — yellowish-white and minimal.

Action items
- Confirm the 1-month well visit is on the calendar (target day 28-35). AAP Bright Futures periodicity schedule: https://www.aap.org/en/practice-management/bright-futures/bright-futures-tools-and-resources/
- Research and waitlist a music-and-movement class for the first 6 months. Bay Area waitlists are real for in-person classes; remote enrollment is faster. Music Together is the most widely available franchise: https://www.musictogether.com/find
- If 529 plan is not yet opened, do it today. Front-loading early years compounds maximally. 529 plan overview on Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/529_plan
- Set up a recurring photo backup. Apple iCloud or Google Photos partner sharing — both work. Goal: one photo per day for year 1.
- Continue the feeding log.

Watch-fors
- [low concern] Cord stump may have detached. Mother's bleeding now lochia serosa or alba (light pink-brown or yellow-white). Baby acne resolving.
- [low concern] Increased fussiness in the evenings without other concerning signs.
- [monitor] Cord site looking wet or smelling slightly off if stump still attached.
- [call within 24h] Yellow tinge spreading or persisting beyond day 14. Persistent inability to latch. Fewer than six wet diapers per day. Mother's bleeding heavier than three days ago.
- [call now] Rectal temperature at or above 100.4F (38.0C). Lethargy, refusal of all feeds, blue or grey color, breathing faster than 60 per minute at rest, persistent grunting, projectile or bilious-green vomiting. Call 911 for blue lips or unresponsiveness!

Enrichment opportunity
Live music exposure during an awake-alert window — sing or hum to Avi for 2-5 minutes. Recorded music in the background is fine; the active ingredient for both bonding and prosodic learning is live human voice. Trainor LJ et al. (Dev Sci 2012) on live vs passive music exposure: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22356269/

Upcoming
- Day 14-21: first common growth spurt.
- Day 28-35: 1-month well visit window opens; first social smiles begin.
- Day 35-42: peak of the PURPLE crying curve at about 6 weeks corrected age.
- Day 42: maternal 6-week postpartum visit (clearance for exercise and intimacy).

Further reading
- Music Together find-a-class directory: https://www.musictogether.com/find
- AAP HealthyChildren overview of the first month: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/Pages/default.aspx
- 529 plan overview on Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/529_plan
- The Happiest Baby on the Block by Harvey Karp: https://www.happiestbaby.com/pages/dr-harvey-karp
